name: transcript-vault
description: Encrypts idle Claude Code session transcripts at rest (X25519 + XChaCha20-Poly1305), decrypts them on demand for /resume, and lets Claude search the encrypted history.

keyMode.title: Key protection
keyMode.description: keystore: key kept by the OS (Windows DPAPI, macOS Keychain, Linux Secret Service), no prompts. passphrase: key protected by a passphrase you enter with /vault unlock each session.

maskSecrets.title: Mask secrets in transcripts
maskSecrets.description: Replace API keys, tokens, private keys and password assignments with [REDACTED:kind] as rows are saved. The model sees the masked text too.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes before encrypting
idleMinutes.description: A session untouched this long is encrypted at the next session start. Sessions that ended cleanly are encrypted right away.

projectsDir.title: Transcripts folder override
projectsDir.description: Leave empty to use <Claude config dir>/projects. For testing on a copy.
